news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 该版本修复了 LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后导致的插件兼容问题；llm-tools-datasette 是使用 httpx 但未直接依赖它的插件之一，现已修复。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 说明依赖传递变化可能悄无声息地破坏插件，也提醒插件应显式声明依赖。
news.summary_en: This release fixes breakage caused when LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2; llm-tools-datasette was one plugin that used httpx without directly depending on it.
news.why_it_matters_en: It shows how transitive dependency changes can silently break plugins, and why explicit dependencies matter.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 是一个调试插件，提供一个不涉及 LLM 的“模型”，只把收到的提示词重复回来；0.5 版更新了模拟 token 用量计数，以计入工具调用、系统提示词等因素。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 有助于在无需真实模型的情况下测试提示词和用量统计。
news.summary_en: llm-echo is a debug plugin that provides a 'model' not involving an LLM at all—it just repeats back prompts; version 0.5 updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts and related factors.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps test prompts and usage accounting without needing a real model.

top5.title_zh: Elorian首款AI模型Glimpse：面向图像推理
top5.title_en: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
top5.what_zh: Elorian发布首款AI模型Glimpse，主打“用图像推理”而非仅描述图像；据其自身评估，该模型在科学图表推理和短视频字幕任务上优于GPT-6 Astra，在其他视觉推理任务上表现有竞争力。
top5.what_en: Elorian released Glimpse, its first AI model, aimed at reasoning with images rather than only about them. According to Elorian’s own evaluations, it outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
top5.why_zh: 若独立验证成立，视觉推理能力可改善图表、文档和视频理解类应用；但当前性能结论来自厂商自评，需谨慎看待。
top5.why_en: If independently validated, visual reasoning could improve chart, document and video-understanding applications. But the performance claims are vendor-reported and should be treated cautiously.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 方向值得关注，尤其是“用图像推理”的定位；但核心基准结论缺少独立复现，暂不宜当作定论。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The direction is worth watching, especially the “reason with images” framing, but the benchmark claims lack independent replication and should not be treated as settled.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：多模态分析与视频理解工具可能受益。风险：厂商评估可能存在选择性展示，实际泛化能力待验证。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: multimodal analysis and video-understanding tools could benefit. Risk: vendor evaluations may be selective, and real-world generalization remains unproven.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文，并查找独立基准、模型访问方式或第三方评测后再评估采用。
top5.action_en: Read the source and look for independent benchmarks, model access or third-party evaluations before considering adoption.

top5.what_zh: 报道称，相关代理通过应用配置、公共代码仓库中暴露的凭证和连接设置，以及过度宽松的云角色进入系统。
top5.what_en: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 这凸显代理式AI的运营安全风险：问题未必是“代理自主作恶”，而可能是凭证与权限管理失守。
top5.why_en: It highlights operational security risks in agentic AI: the issue may not be autonomous malice but failed credential and permission management.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 这是实用的安全警示，重点应放在暴露凭证、公共仓库和过宽云权限，而非渲染“失控AI”。
top5.editor_judgment_en: A practical security warning. The focus should be exposed credentials, public repos and overly broad cloud roles, not “rogue AI” sensationalism.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：推动凭证审计、最小权限和代理行为监控。风险：未授权访问、数据泄露或代理被滥用。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: drive credential audits, least privilege and agent behavior monitoring. Risk: unauthorized access, data leaks or agent misuse.
top5.action_zh: 审计暴露的凭证与公共仓库，收紧云角色权限并轮换密钥；同时阅读原文核实范围。
top5.action_en: Audit exposed credentials and public repositories, tighten cloud roles and rotate secrets; read the source to verify scope.
top5.original_title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity

editorial.core_zh: 本期重点不在单一模型参数，而在AI治理、企业落地、人才重组与代理安全；能力声明与治理结构都需要更独立的验证。
editorial.core_en: The focus this cycle is less on raw model specs and more on AI governance, enterprise deployment, talent reshuffling and agent security; both capability claims and governance structures need more independent verification.
editorial.trend_zh: AI竞争正从“模型能力”延伸到“可信部署”：治理平台、所有权结构、安全运维和人才整合成为差异化要素。
editorial.trend_en: AI competition is extending from model capability to trustworthy deployment: governance platforms, ownership structures, security operations and talent consolidation are becoming differentiators.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当模型能力多由厂商自评、代理权限又常被粗放配置时，企业该由谁来做独立验证与权限审计？
editorial.next_question_en: When model capabilities are largely vendor-reported and agent permissions are often loosely configured, who should provide independent validation and permission audits for enterprises?
